_doctrine: R-023: the baseline contract. Deck 1 BEATS = what a PLAIN tutorial on this concept would minimally need (derived from the concept, not the inventory); each beat is a ROLE cast with one artifact (alts = understudies). Deck 2 VOLTAGE = the few pieces a plain tutorial would never include -- the critical script, the thinker with QFEP. Everything uncast is AT DEPTH: kept, honored by the dig line, not needed by the book or the walk.

voltage.why: the grammar as INHERITED LANGUAGE — Lindenmayer, Islamic subdivision, Aboriginal kinship: same engine, different worlds. Whose rules got called universal? The alphabet is never neutral.
branching as GROWTH-AS-WRITING — the reef writes itself in F[+F][-F]; morphology is a sentence the organism keeps rewriting, not a plan it obeys
the stochastic/context rule as the MUTATION — deviation is where the grammar bends to its world; the pruned branch is the rule that refused to repeat itself (the queer turn on inheritance)
rewriting as THE CODE THAT GROWS ITSELF — the grammar leaves the plant and lays a city; a rule set becomes infrastructure, structure authored by iteration not decree
